title: Lam Research (LRCX) Rose on AI Data Center and Memory Spending
excerpt: Columbia Threadneedle Investments, an investment management company, released its “Columbia Seligman Global Technology Fund” second quarter 2026 investor let...
content_html:
Soumya Eswaran

Tue, July 28, 2026 at 6:57 AM PDT 3 min read

Columbia Threadneedle Investments, an investment management company, released its "Columbia Seligman Global Technology Fund" second quarter 2026 investor letter. A copy of the letter can be downloaded here. During the quarter, the Fund's Institutional Class shares returned 50.34%, outperforming the MSCI World Information Technology Index's 33.65% gain. Stock selection in semiconductors, technology hardware and software, together with an off-benchmark electrical equipment allocation, supported relative performance, while exposure to financials, consumer discretionary and healthcare detracted. Technology stocks rallied as concerns over the Iran conflict eased and AI infrastructure spending boosted demand for semiconductors, memory, networking, servers and power solutions. The Fund expects AI and data-centre investment to remain strong, supported by broadening earnings growth and improving software bookings, cloud consumption and customer spending. However, geopolitical uncertainty, higher interest rates and heavy AI investment could pressure valuations and free cash flow. The strategy holds 50–75 technology companies across market capitalisations and uses bottom-up GARP research to identify misunderstood and undervalued businesses in the technology industry. In addition, please check the Fund's top five holdings to know its best picks in 2026.

In its second-quarter 2026 investor letter, Columbia Seligman Global Technology Fund highlighted Lam Research Corporation (NASDAQ:LRCX). Lam Research Corporation (NASDAQ:LRCX) designs, manufactures, markets, refurbishes, and services semiconductor processing equipment used in the fabrication of integrated circuits. On July 27, 2026, Lam Research Corporation (NASDAQ:LRCX) closed at $291.61 per share. One-month return of Lam Research Corporation (NASDAQ:LRCX) was -32.70% and its shares gained 194.73% over the past 52 weeks. Lam Research Corporation (NASDAQ:LRCX) has a market capitalization of $364.68 billion with a 52-week trading range between $90.94 – $438.50.

Columbia Seligman Global Technology Fund stated the following regarding Lam Research Corporation (NASDAQ:LRCX) in its Q2 2026 investor letter:

"Lam Research Corporation (NASDAQ:LRCX) was one of the largest positions in the fund during the quarter. The stock appreciated as investors became increasingly optimistic that AI-driven data-center spending would sustain robust demand for advanced semiconductor manufacturing equipment, while memory customers accelerated investments in high-bandwidth memory and dynamic random-access memory (DRAM) capacity. Lam stock also benefited from improving semiconductor-industry fundamentals, strong earnings execution and growing confidence that leading-edge logic and memory capital expenditures would remain elevated through 2026, supporting Lam's revenue and margin outlook."

太平洋夏令时间 2026 年 7 月 28 日星期二上午 6:57 阅读 3 分钟

投资管理公司 Columbia Threadneedle Investments 发布了“哥伦比亚塞利格曼全球科技基金”2026 年第二季度投资者信函。 该信函的副本可以在此处下载。 本季度，该基金的机构类别股票回报率为 50.34%，跑赢 MSCI 世界信息技术指数 33.65% 的涨幅。 半导体、技术硬件和软件的股票选择以及非基准电气设备配置支撑了相对表现，而金融、非必需消费品和医疗保健的敞口则受到影响。 随着对伊朗冲突的担忧缓解以及人工智能基础设施支出提振了对半导体、内存、网络、服务器和电源解决方案的需求，科技股上涨。 该基金预计，在盈利增长扩大以及软件预订、云消费和客户支出改善的支持下，人工智能和数据中心投资将保持强劲。 然而，地缘政治的不确定性、较高的利率和大量的人工智能投资可能会给估值和自由现金流带来压力。 该战略持有 50-75 家不同市值的科技公司，并利用自下而上的 GARP 研究来识别科技行业中被误解和低估的企业。 此外，请查看该基金的前五名持股，以了解其2026年的最佳选择。

哥伦比亚塞利格曼全球技术基金在其 2026 年第二季度投资者信函中重点关注了泛林研究公司（纳斯达克股票代码：LRCX）。 Lam Research Corporation（纳斯达克股票代码：LRCX）设计、制造、销售、翻新和服务用于集成电路制造的半导体加工设备。 2026 年 7 月 27 日，泛林研究公司（纳斯达克股票代码：LRCX）收于每股 291.61 美元。 Lam Research Corporation（纳斯达克股票代码：LRCX）的一个月回报率为-32.70%，其股价在过去 52 周内上涨了 194.73%。 Lam Research Corporation（纳斯达克股票代码：LRCX）的市值为 3,646.8 亿美元，52 周交易区间为 90.94 美元至 438.50 美元。

哥伦比亚塞利格曼全球技术基金在其 2026 年第二季度投资者信函中就 Lam Research Corporation（纳斯达克股票代码：LRCX）发表了以下声明：

“泛林研究公司（纳斯达克股票代码：LRCX）是本季度该基金持仓量最大的公司之一。 由于投资者越来越乐观地认为人工智能驱动的数据中心支出将维持对先进半导体制造设备的强劲需求，而存储器客户加速了对高带宽存储器和动态随机存取存储器（DRAM）容量的投资，该股上涨。 Lam 股票还受益于半导体行业基本面的改善、强劲的盈利执行力以及对领先逻辑和内存资本支出将在 2026 年保持高位的信心不断增强，从而支撑了 Lam 的收入和利润前景。”
